morning3_start.name: Me
morning3_start.text: *Day three. I overslept. I turned off my alarm three times. Blame it on staying up late replying to all three of them last night.*

morning3_start_2.name: Me
morning3_start_2.text: *I sprint down the road to school. — The school gate comes into view. And then.*

morning3_seo_gate_1.name: Me
morning3_seo_gate_1.text: *서연(Seoyeon) is standing in front of the gate. Not in any hurry.*

morning3_seo_gate_4.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
morning3_seo_gate_4.text: "So what if we're late? If we get caught together, maybe the punishment won't be so bad?"

morning3_seo_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_5.text: "I don't think that's how it works."

morning3_seo_gate_7.name: Me
morning3_seo_gate_7.text: *서연(Seoyeon) walks ahead. Confidently. She doesn't rush, even though she's late. — This girl is poised even when she's tardy. No, it's more like acting poised is second nature to her.*

morning3_yuna_gate_1.name: Me
morning3_yuna_gate_1.text: *I spot 유나(Yuna) standing blankly in front of the gate. Her eyes are half-closed.*

morning3_yuna_gate_5.name: 유나(Yuna)
morning3_yuna_gate_5.text: "...I had to know the ending. I couldn't stop."

morning3_yuna_gate_6.name: Me
morning3_yuna_gate_6.text: *Someone who stays up all night reading and ends up late. — Admirable or hopeless, either way, that's so 유나(Yuna).*

morning3_yuna_gate_7.name: Me
morning3_yuna_gate_7.text: *유나(Yuna) pulls a small bread roll from her bag. We share it as we slowly walk through the gate.*

morning3_dain_gate_1.name: Me
morning3_dain_gate_1.text: *Near the gate, 다인(Dain) comes sprinting at full speed.*

morning3_dain_gate_3.name: Me
morning3_dain_gate_3.text: *다인(Dain) grabs my hand without warning and starts running.*

morning3_dain_gate_4.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_4.text: "Wait — why are you holding my hand?!"

morning3_dain_gate_5.name: Me
morning3_dain_gate_5.text: *Her hand is warm. Is it sweat, or is it my heart? — No time to think while running.*

morning3_classroom_1.name: Me
morning3_classroom_1.text: *As I enter the classroom, I feel the stares of the other two who witnessed my arrival companion.*

morning3_react_seo_1.name: 다인(Dain)
morning3_react_seo_1.text: "Hey! You came with the class president?! This early in the morning?!"

morning3_react_seo_2.name: Me
morning3_react_seo_2.text: *유나(Yuna) turns her gaze from the window, glances this way briefly. — Then back to the window.*

morning3_react_yuna_1.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
morning3_react_yuna_1.text: "Walking in with the library girl first thing in the morning?"

morning3_react_yuna_2.name: 다인(Dain)
morning3_react_yuna_2.text: "So jealous!! I wish I had someone to walk to school with too!!"

morning3_react_dain_1.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
morning3_react_dain_1.text: "Quite the cardio workout this morning. Want me to share my lunch box later?"

morning3_react_dain_2.name: Me
morning3_react_dain_2.text: *유나(Yuna) is quietly observing. It looks like she's writing a note.*

morning3_date_intro.name: Me
morning3_date_intro.text: *First period ends. Break time. — All three approach me, one after another.*

morning3_date_seo_1.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
morning3_date_seo_1.text: "Are you free this weekend? There's somewhere I want to go."

morning3_date_seo_choice.name: Me
morning3_date_seo_choice.text: *서연(Seoyeon) asks casually as she passes me in the hallway.*
choices: "I think I'll be kind of busy"

morning3_date_seo_accept.name: Me
morning3_date_seo_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with 서연(Seoyeon).*

morning3_date_dain_1.name: 다인(Dain)
morning3_date_dain_1.text: "Hey! What are you doing this weekend?! Wanna hit the arcade together?!"

morning3_date_dain_2.name: Me
morning3_date_dain_2.text: *다인(Dain)'s fingers are tapping the edge of the desk. Is she nervous? — No way. 다인(Dain) doesn't get nervous. This is just everyday stuff for her.*

morning3_date_dain_choice.name: Me
morning3_date_dain_choice.text: *다인(Dain) comes to my desk during break and asks.*

morning3_date_dain_accept.name: Me
morning3_date_dain_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with 다인(Dain).*

morning3_date_dain_decline.name: 다인(Dain)
morning3_date_dain_decline.text: "Oh, okay? Well, if you're busy, can't be helped!"

morning3_date_dain_decline_inner.name: Me
morning3_date_dain_decline_inner.text: *She walked away with a bright smile. — I didn't realize it then. That 다인(Dain) had stopped tapping her fingers and slipped her hands into her pockets. That it had taken courage to ask.*

morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.name: Me
morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.text: *I pride myself on being perceptive. — Yet I get it wrong at the moments that matter most.*

morning3_date_yuna_1.name: Me
morning3_date_yuna_1.text: *A note from 유나(Yuna) is sitting on my desk.*

morning3_date_yuna_2.name: Me
morning3_date_yuna_2.text: *'Weekend. Going to the used bookstore. Come if you want. — 유나(Yuna)'*

morning3_date_yuna_choice.name: Me
choices: I fold the note and put it in my pocket

morning3_date_yuna_accept.name: Me
morning3_date_yuna_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with 유나(Yuna).*

morning3_date_yuna_decline.name: Me
morning3_date_yuna_decline.text: *I quietly folded the note and slipped it into my pocket.*

morning3_set_multiple.name: Me
morning3_set_multiple.text: *...Wait. My weekend plans are overlapping. What do I do now.*

morning3_end.name: Me
morning3_end.text: *My weekend plans are overlapping... Before I know it, classes continue and lunchtime approaches.*
